name: Dragon's Breath

targets.description: one willing creature, who then breathes the Cone

summary: A willing creature can breathe a 15-ft Cone as a Magic action: 3d6 of a chosen type, Dex save for half.
text: Touch a willing creature and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison. Until the spell ends, that creature can take a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failure or half as much on a success. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
